properties.description: Implement independently runnable deterministic checks that inventory the current UI components and identify violations of the agreed component constraints. Cover one component per source file, registered custom-element identity, safe construction without arguments, and a visible empty default without sample data, service setup or per-component editor adapters. Derive discovery from source and contributor-owned contracts; report unsupported or uncertain cases explicitly so the inventory is not silently incomplete. Report each check separately with exact component/source identities, observed results and reproducible evidence. Distinguish measurable rendering checks from visual usability, which remains a human review. Provide clear commands and results the user can run and inspect. Do not start component rework before the following check review is accepted.
properties.title: Develop granular deterministic UI component checks
